title: People’s Mañanera August 11
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**The security strategy is working: homicides down 51%  
** In 22 months, homicides have fallen 51%, from 86.9 to 42.5 per day, 44
fewer murders each day. July posted the lowest figures in the past 12 years.

**The reduction in violence is advancing across the country  
** The daily average number of homicides in 30 states declined compared to
2025. Guanajuato stands out with a -76% reduction, Guerrero -61%, State of
Mexico -59%, Sinaloa -52%, Morelos -51%, and Baja California -48%.

**Cooperation yes, shared responsibility as well  
** Of the more than 30,000 weapons that have been seized, around 80% come from
the U.S. “We have asked for more work in the United States to prevent weapons
from reaching Mexico,” President Claudia Sheinbaum said.

**“We do not cover up for anyone”  
** In relation to the investigations into fuel smuggling with falsified
invoices, known as “huachicól fiscal,” it was clarified that the Federal
Attorney General’s Office (FGR) is investigating the entry of fuel from the
U.S., while the Agency for Security, Energy, and the Environment (ASEA) is
being strengthened, along with QR code tracking and information cross-checking
by the Tax Administration Service (SAT).

**Today there is freedom, and audiences have rights  
** The President recalled that previously those who fought to transform the
country were spied upon, persecuted, imprisoned, and forcibly disappeared;
today there is full freedom of expression and audience rights are being
strengthened.

**What was recovered from García Luna will be returned to the people  
** It was reported that nearly US$500,000 recovered from Genaro García Luna,
former Minister of Security who is currently imprisoned in the United States
on drug trafficking charges, has already been deposited into the Treasury and
will be allocated for a special purpose. The Financial Investigation Unit
(UIF) will soon present further details.
